chunks: And Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni narrated (elevating it) said:

Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) said when the Proof (al-Hujjah) was born: 'The oppressors presumed that they would kill me to cut off this progeny. So how did they witness the might of Allah?' Then he named him al-Mu'mal.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمَل: Al-Mu'mal (The one in whom hopes rest)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Hasan al-Askari say about the birth of Imam Mahdi and his name?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kulayni highlights the theological significance of Imam Hasan al-Askari's (a.s.) declaration regarding the birth of the Mahdi (a.s.), emphasizing that the Abbasid oppressors' attempt to extinguish the Imamate through the 'Sicil al-A'zam' (Great Slaughter) ultimately failed due to divine decree. By naming him 'al-Mu'mal' (the Expected One), the Imam established a key title reflecting the Shia eschatological hope, while contrasting human political machinations with the omnipotence of Allah. This event underscores the concept of 'Ghaybah' (occultation) as a divinely ordained period of waiting rather than a cessation of spiritual authority.
